Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the call — attaching the benchmark report Marcus ran against the model family we discussed. High-level summary below and a couple of configuration notes so you can compare apples-to-apples: 

- Test config: gpt-3.5-style open model, sequence length 128, batch sizing tuned to keep p95 under target at the stated concurrency.
- Observed: p50 = 62 ms, p95 = 210 ms at 120 RPS sustained with continuous batching enabled.
- Throughput: ~145 tokens/s per GPU equivalent under our batching strategy; horizontal scaling linearly increases overall throughput.
- Notes: Prefix caching for repeated prompts reduced token cost by ~18% in the test set. Quantized variant trimmed GPU memory footprint with ~10% slower p95 vs. float baseline.

Attachments: acme_latency_report_v1.pdf (contains detailed charts), throughput_benchmarks.csv (raw measurements).

If you want, we can run the same test with one of your representative prompts or import a small sample to get closer to your expected distributions.

Best,
